notes.title: Become the best!
notes.notes:
To achieve such a feat, it is better to fully understand how the score works in the game. As a hard-working player, you may have already grasped all its subtleties! If not, here is an explanation that may be useful to you.

[h1]Make the most slabs disappear at once[/h1]
[list]
[*]You score far more points if you manage to remove several slabs at once than separately.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/d63eba263ec3b92905fe27da92b01eb8f429a995.png[/img]

[h1]The importance of steps[/h1]
[list]
[*]As you remove slabs, the difficulty level increases. Blocks fall more frequently and quickly, but on the other hand, the score obtained with each disappearance of stabs also increases!
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/867e0a7acfbc75b7e2134bdac6cbde32ad2c22af.jpg[/img]

[h1]Even blocks earn points[/h1]
[list]
[*]For each block placed, you score a small number of points. So until the end of the game, try to put as many blocks as possible, you can collect valuable points!
[/list][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/bf32f9bdd522485b83eae55562c2a2e069408c80.png[/img]

[i]You can find these detailed explanations in the game, in the "Tips" section accessible from one of the screens of the five levels[/i].

- RealityZ team

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 released - Level 5 and balancing
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/c27bad534b3dc4bfea9bb24ab4da38f1a952e04a.jpg[/img]

Hello,

This week, we present you the 5th and last level of this early access! New environment, new music, new grid and new block!

For balancing purposes, we have reorganized the distribution of grids and blocks between levels. Your landmarks may be a little upset, but don't panic, it'll be fine!

[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Level 5[/b] - You can unlock it by scoring 4000 on level 4.[/list]
h1][b]Modified[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The content of the levels has been distributed differently between the current levels (the grid and special blocks from the old level 2 are now associated with level 5; the grid and special block from the old level 4 are now associated with level 2; the new grid and special block are associated with level 4.
[*]A button replaces the old instruction on the epilepsy risk warning screen[/list].
[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
Minor noise corrections.[/list]

Thank you for being more and more present on the leaderboard. We look forward to following its evolution on all five levels!

- RealityZ team

notes.title: Development roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/eae8d2fb93e683b23bfdb3908941538fa5d92c50.jpg[/img]

Hello! 
As you have noticed, Beat Blocks VR has been released on early access. Hourray! We want to continue its development with you until it is ready. For this, we will need your feedback, whether it concerns bugs or suggestions. Feel free to share it with us on the discussion forum.

To bring more clarity to our development, we have set up a [url=https://trello.com/b/iYxpq4b1/beat-blocks-vr]Trello public board[/url], on which you can follow our progress. We create maps on features under development or bugs that we are dealing with.

notes.title: Beat Block VR will be available at November 12th
notes.notes:
Hello,

We wanted to announce that [b]Beat Blocks VR[/b] will finally be released on [b]Monday, November 12[/b].
Indeed, it was important to be able to offer our game to our curators, various professionals, in order to get initial feedback. 

This decision allows us to provide you with [b]the best possible experience[/b].

The weekend will pass quickly, don't worry, and the game will be available from Monday, 9am. 

Thank you again for your support, we look forward to it, as do you.

- The RealityZ team
